alert.title: Severe Weather Warnings & Advisories
alert.subtitle: Official meteorological bulletins & actionable farm disaster mitigation
alert.imdHeadline: IMD Red Alert: Squall and heavy downpours expected across coastal and central Andhra Pradesh
alert.descriptionText: An active low-pressure depression over the Bay of Bengal is predicted to cause widespread thunderstorms with squally winds (45-55 km/h) and heavy precipitation (65-115 mm) over the next 48 hours. Farmers are advised to take precautionary safeguards for standing crops and irrigation infrastructure.
alert.paddyImpact: Water stagnation risk in flowering stage and lodging risk due to gusty winds.
alert.paddyAdvisory: Clear bund outlets and open field drainage trenches to drain excess water within 12 hours.
alert.cottonImpact: Square and boll shedding hazard due to prolonged waterlogging and root asphyxiation.
alert.cottonAdvisory: Create sub-surface trenches across slopes; do not spray pesticides during rainfall.
alert.chilliImpact: Anthracnose fruit rot development risk and wilt caused by water-saturated soil.
alert.chilliAdvisory: Spray copper oxychloride (3g/L) immediately after rain subsides; avoid water accumulation.
alert.action1: Inspect and clean field drainage channels immediately to prevent waterlogging.
alert.action2: Move harvested produce and bags to elevated, watertight indoor storage or tarpaulin sheds.
alert.action3: Anchor temporary farm machinery, sprayers, and nursery shade nets against squalls.
alert.action4: Shift livestock away from low-lying pastures and high-tension electrical lines.
alert.dont1: Do not apply chemical fertilizers or pesticides during or immediately prior to rain.
alert.dont2: Do not seek shelter under isolated trees, metal structures, or near power poles during lightning.
alert.dont3: Do not leave irrigation motors or electric pumps connected in flood-prone farm plots.

paddy.title: Paddy Stem Borer & Leaf Blast Management
paddy.diagnosis: Yellow stem borer (Scirpophaga incertulas) causing dead hearts and white ears, coupled with fungal blast lesions.
paddy.symptom1: Central shoot drying ('dead hearts') during tillering stage.
paddy.symptom2: Spindle-shaped elliptical brown lesions on leaf blades with grey centers.
paddy.remedy1: Apply Cartap hydrochloride 50% SP @ 400g/acre or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 60ml/acre in 200L water.
paddy.remedy2: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 120g/acre to arrest fungal blast development.
paddy.remedy3: Release egg parasitoid Trichogramma japonicum @ 40,000/acre at weekly intervals.
paddy.preventive1: Avoid excessive urea/nitrogen application; maintain 5cm water level during tillering.

cotton.title: Pink Bollworm & Sucking Pest Control
cotton.diagnosis: Pink bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella) larvae boring into flower buds and green bolls, with whitefly sap-sucking.
cotton.symptom1: Rosetted flowers that fail to open fully ('rosette flower symptom').
cotton.symptom2: Premature square and boll drop with tiny entry bore holes on boll surfaces.
cotton.remedy1: Install 5-8 pheromone traps per acre with Gossyplure septa for population monitoring.
cotton.remedy2: Spray Emamectin benzoate 5% SG @ 100g/acre or Profenofos 50% EC @ 400ml/acre in 200L water.
cotton.preventive1: Collect and destroy dropped squares/bolls; do not extend crop season beyond 150 days.

chilli.title: Chilli Leaf Curl Virus & Thrips Eradication
chilli.diagnosis: Upward curling caused by Scirtothrips dorsalis feeding, transmitting Begomovirus leaf curl disease.
chilli.symptom1: Upward curling of leaf margins, reduced leaf size, and stunted bush formation.
chilli.symptom2: Crinkled leaves with brittle texture and poor flowering/fruit set.
chilli.remedy1: Spray Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 180ml/acre or Fipronil 5% SC @ 400ml/acre thoroughly on underside of leaves.
chilli.remedy2: Erect 15-20 blue and yellow sticky cards per acre to trap adult vector thrips.
chilli.preventive1: Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) at early vegetative stage; uproot virus-infected plants.

general.title: Balanced Soil Nutrition & Eco-Friendly Pest Shield
general.diagnosis: General crop health optimization and natural defense enhancement against climate and pest stresses.
general.symptom1: Mild pale foliage or early seasonal insect presence.
general.remedy1: Apply 5ml/L cold-pressed neem oil (10,000 ppm) with 1ml liquid soap early in the morning.
general.remedy2: Ensure adequate field drainage; avoid waterlogging around root zones.
